title: AUTOMATE ATTENTION
author: diid
facts: INT8 per-channel quantized, stored in onchain data contracts
RoPE, RMSNorm, SiLU, KV cache — all in EVM opcodes
one aphorism per NFT, rendered as onchain SVG
description: This contract is a complete transformer language model that runs inside Ethereum. Data contracts on Ethereum store its weights. A companion NFT contract calls the model to write one permanent aphorism for each token. The model also draws the text as an SVG image inside Ethereum. The address here is the language model itself.

call.note: logits([1]) — runs the model once and returns int16 scores (logits) for all 2048 vocabulary tokens

preview.note: The most likely next tokens. Token IDs become text only with the project's off-chain vocabulary.
